title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 3.2 Domain and Range: Find the domain of a function defined by an equation.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 3.2 Domain and Range: Find the domain of a function defined by an equation.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "3.2 Domain and Range", prints these objectives: "Find the domain of a function defined by an equation." "Graph piecewise-defined functions.". The section text says: "Horror and thriller movies are both popular and, very often, extremely profitable. When big-budget actors, shooting locations, and special effects are included, however, studios count on even more viewership to be successful. Consider five major thriller/horror entries from the early 2000s— I am Legend , Hannibal , The Ring , The Grudge , and The Conjuring . Figure 1 shows the amount, in dollars, each of those movies grossed when they were released as well as the ticket sales for horror movies…" This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
